prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” roofing company for every homeowner — the best one for you depends on your roof type, budget, whether it’s an insurance claim, and how important things like warranties and turnaround time are.

How to find the best roofing contractor in Dallas
- Get at least 3 written estimates so you can compare scope and price.
- Verify they follow local requirements: confirm they will pull required permits and comply with City of Dallas rules.
- Ask for proof of insurance: general liability and workers’ compensation (certificate of insurance).
- Check for manufacturer certification (e.g., GAF, Owens Corning) if you want extended warranties.
- Check reviews and complaints: Google, BBB, Yelp, and local Facebook/neighborhood groups. Ask for recent local references and call them.
- Confirm warranties: manufacturer (shingle) warranty vs. contractor workmanship warranty, length, and transferability.
- Ask about materials and installation details: tear-off vs overlay, underlayment type, ventilation, flashing, drip edge, disposal of old materials.
- Beware of storm-chaser companies after big storms — prefer a local, established contractor with a permanent office and local references.
- Get a clear payment schedule and contract (start/end dates, cleanup, lien waivers, change-order process).

Questions to ask each roofer
- Are you licensed/registered where required and insured? Can I have a certificate of insurance?
- Are you manufacturer-certified for the shingle/roof system I plan to use?
- Can you provide three recent local references and photos of recent jobs?
- Will you pull permits and schedule inspections?
- What exactly is included in the estimate (tear-off, roofing nails vs staples, underlayment, vent replacement, ice & water shield, etc.)?
- What warranties are provided and are they written?
- Who will supervise the job and contact for issues?

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated roofing companies in Dallas right now (tell me your ZIP code).
- Help you compare 2–3 estimates if you paste them here.
- Provide a sample checklist/contract addendum to use with contractors.

Which would you prefer?
